headline.en: Sound Point hires Ninety One's European secured lending team
headline.zh: Sound Point 聘请 Ninety One 的欧洲担保贷款团队

summary.en: Sound Point Capital Management has hired a three-person investment team from Ninety One as part of a partnership between the two firms. Chris Rust and Lei Lei become portfolio managers and co-heads of European secured lending, with Lachlan Viney as director and senior analyst, all based in London. The partnership aims to support completion of the Ninety One European Credit Opportunities Fund 1 and expand Sound Point's European private credit offering. Sound Point manages over $44bn in assets.
summary.zh: Sound Point Capital Management 作为与 Ninety One 合作的一部分，聘请了 Ninety One 的一支三人投资团队。Chris Rust 和 Lei Lei 被任命为投资组合经理兼欧洲担保贷款联席主管，Lachlan Viney 被任命为董事兼高级分析师，三人均在伦敦办公。该合作旨在支持完成 Ninety One European Credit Opportunities Fund 1，并扩展 Sound Point 的欧洲私募信贷业务。Sound Point 管理资产超过 440 亿美元。

items.source_headline: Sound Point hires Ninety One’s European secured lending team

reason.en: A team hire and partnership between two untracked credit managers indicates continued build-out of European asset-backed lending; incremental for sector competition but no tracked manager involvement.
reason.zh: 两家未跟踪的信贷管理机构之间的团队招聘与合作，显示欧洲资产支持贷款业务持续扩张；对行业竞争而言属增量信息，但无被跟踪管理机构参与。

items.relevance_reason: A credit manager's team move and new European asset-backed lending partnership signals competitive and deployment shifts in European private credit, though no tracked manager is involved.

headline.en: ACORE Capital launches wealth solutions platform for real estate credit
headline.zh: ACORE Capital推出财富解决方案平台，聚焦房地产信贷

summary.en: ACORE Capital has launched a dedicated wealth solutions platform to widen access to its commercial real estate investment strategies, offering high-net-worth investors in-house real estate credit underwriting across credit and select equity investments. Mick Manning, formerly a managing director at Apollo's bridge investment group, has been appointed president of the division, overseeing strategy, product development and distribution. CEO Warren de Haan called the launch a natural extension of the platform built over the past decade.
summary.zh: ACORE Capital推出专门的财富解决方案平台，以扩大其商业房地产投资策略的覆盖面，为高净值投资者提供涵盖信贷及部分股权投资的内部房地产信贷承销能力。曾在Apollo旗下bridge investment group担任董事总经理的Mick Manning被任命为该部门总裁，负责战略、产品开发和分销。首席执行官Warren de Haan称此次推出是过去十年所建平台的自然延伸。

reason.zh: 已评估严重程度：有限；关联程度：行业。

items.relevance_reason: New wealth channel for a commercial real estate credit manager expands private real estate credit distribution to high-net-worth investors, a transmission channel to the private credit sub-sector.

headline.en: Pendle Opens Yield Market for Centrifuge deJAAA Tied to Janus Henderson AAA CLO Fund
headline.zh: Pendle 推出与 Janus Henderson AAA CLO 策略挂钩的 deJAAA 收益市场

summary.en: Pendle said on Oct. 21 that a live yield market for Centrifuge's deJAAA product opened on its decentralized finance platform. The deJAAA product is linked to the Janus Henderson Anemoy AAA CLO Fund, and the Pendle market is scheduled to mature Nov. 26, 2026. Janus Henderson separately said Aug. 13 that a AAA CLO ETF surpassed $30 billion in assets under management.
summary.zh: Pendle 于10月21日表示，Centrifuge 的 deJAAA 产品已在其去中心化金融平台上线收益市场。deJAAA 产品挂钩 Janus Henderson Anemoy AAA CLO 基金，该 Pendle 市场计划于2026年11月26日到期。Janus Henderson 另行于8月13日表示，一只 AAA CLO ETF 的管理资产规模已超过300亿美元。

items.source_headline: Pendle Launches deJAAA Yield Market Tied to Janus Henderson CLO Strategy
items.relevance_reason: Tokenized CLO fund distribution expands a credit sub-sector's investor access, though no tracked manager is directly involved.
